verdict.rationale: DBOS provides a Conductor dashboard that lets you monitor, pause, and restart workflows, and exposes this over an OpenAPI HTTP API/CLI for scripting (dbos-docs-16, dbos-docs-17, dbos-probe-rt-4), which gives some visibility into workflow state, but there's no evidence of native metrics export (failure rate, latency, queue depth) to standard observability stacks like Prometheus/Datadog, nor of a built-in alerting mechanism. Community feedback even notes observability wasn't self-hostable initially (dbos-comm-8), though self-hosting Conductor is now documented (dbos-docs-19). Missing for 10: explicit metrics/export integration (Prometheus/OpenTelemetry), documented alerting/alert-rule configuration, and evidence of latency/queue-depth specific dashboards.
